title: The Mace, Finally
description: Adds the mace into earlier versions of minecraft
body:
Mace Mod

Mace Mod adds the powerful Mace weapon from newer Minecraft versions to Forge 1.20.1.

Features

- Fully functional Mace weapon
- Smash attacks that become stronger when falling from greater heights
- Density enchantment that increases smash attack damage
- Wind Burst enchantment that launches the player upward after a successful smash attack
- Custom smash sounds
- Gust particle effects
- Ground impact particles
- Fall-damage immunity after successful smash attacks

The Mace rewards timing and mobility, allowing players to deal massive damage by striking enemies while falling. Higher falls result in stronger smash attacks, while Density increases damage even further. Wind Burst can launch the player back into the air, making chained aerial attacks possible.

Built specifically for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 and designed to feel close to the official Minecraft Mace experience.
